milestones.outcome: A reviewer returning to a pull request with new commits asks what changed since their review and whether a thread was addressed.
exit_criteria: What changed since my review names both revisions and is unavailable, with the reason, when the earlier one cannot be read.
Was this addressed? takes a conversation as its subject and its answer is shown as a claim.
Neither operation resolves, posts or changes attention state, and nothing runs without a press.
Each operation has its own built-in prompt.
milestones.boundary: The two unused entry points analyze_latest_upload and evaluate_proposed_fix get their surfaces. Read-only runs.

milestones.outcome: A reviewer has the open file explained in Review, without going to the Agent tab.
exit_criteria: Explain this file takes the open file as its subject with no selection.
The answer shows at the file header and can be kept as a note, continued or dismissed.
milestones.boundary: The unused entry point analyze_current_file gets its surface. Files only, not selections.

milestones.outcome: A reviewer turns a draft comment into an exact suggested change that core has checked against the lines.
exit_criteria: A reply is taken only as a replacement for the draft's exact lines and accepted only when its stated current text equals the head's lines.
An accepted replacement opens as RFC-BPR-0090's in-pane suggestion edit; a refused one is never shown as a suggestion.
Nothing is sent to GitHub, and one Undo restores the draft.
milestones.boundary: One draft comment at a time, on lines GitHub can take a suggestion on.

milestones.outcome: A reviewer asks the agent why a check failed, from the check's row.
exit_criteria: A check is a question subject, and the brief carries only what BPR already holds, with provider text as quoted data.
BPR downloads no log, passes no credential, reruns nothing and writes nothing.
An agent that cannot read the log answers so, as a claim.
milestones.boundary: RFC-BPR-0068's boundary is unchanged for BPR itself; the agent uses its own GitHub access.

milestones.outcome: An author has the agent run a planned check on a local draft and accepts the reported result into evidence.
exit_criteria: An agent-run result is recorded as reported, never observed, with its commands and limitations.
The result is bound to the candidate only when the worktree equals it before and after the run.
A failed result is kept, and nothing enters evidence or is published without the author.
milestones.boundary: Needs RFC-BPR-0109's evidence record and RFC-BPR-0115's change runs first.

milestones.outcome: Insights shows, per agent feature, the runs, the reported spend and how many suggestions were kept.
exit_criteria: Runs, endings and reported spend per feature match the sessions that produced them; a missing cost is Not reported.
Kept, dismissed and neither are counted once and never decrease.
The export holds counts and sums only, and an agent feature with no row fails a test.
milestones.boundary: A record of what was kept, not of what was right. No budgets or alerts.
